title: Sinfall
description: The study of sins: How to use them or how to get rid of them!
body:
**The Fall Begins With You!**

_Sinfall_ is an ambitious magic and adventure mod that redefines the _Seven Deadly Sins_. They are not mere vices, but primordial forces of reality. Will you harness their corrupting power for your own ends, or seek to purify them and restore balance?

**The Corruption Begins:**

_The Abyss_ is not a place you can visit. It is a dormant energy, a corrupting influence beyond the edges of reality. Your journey begins by creating and eating a _Abyss Fruit_. This single act fractures the barrier, allowing _the Abyss_ to seep into the world... and into your very soul. From that moment, you become a conduit for Sin, manifesting its power directly into the world through _spells_ and _rituals_, summoning its creatures and wielding its terrifying potential.

**Development Progress (SDS):**

🟢 Sloth : In Progress (~30%) <-- [Current Focus] \
🟢 Gluttony : In Progress (~10%) \
🔴 Lust : Not Started \
🔴 Envy : Not Started \
🔴 Wrath : Not Started \
🔴 Greed : Not Started \
🔴 Pride : Not Started

_This is only the beginning of your fall or redemption. The mod is in active development, with more Sins, creatures, and spells to come. The power of the Abyss is in your hands. What will you become?_
